task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for EXT-03 at src/design/ext-03-plugin-interface.md. Define a stable in-process plugin interface for custom node type handlers registered at startup only. Specify interface contracts for registration, handler invocation context (instance variables and node config), and allowed outcomes COMPLETE (optional output variables) and ERROR (reason string). Define precedence rule where plugin handlers shadow built-in handlers for the same node type. Specify panic-handling semantics: caught handler panic is mapped to ERROR and routed through EE-10 behavior. Include versioning and compatibility constraints for the stable Zig interface and identify what constitutes a breaking API change. Map module boundaries and implementation touchpoints across engine execution path, plugin registry, startup wiring, and error/variable merge integration (EE-09, EE-10). Include a complete requirement traceability matrix mapping all EXT-03 acceptance criteria and edge cases to modules/functions and required tests (unit + integration). Design only; do not modify implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: Design fully maps all EXT-03 acceptance criteria and edge cases to concrete behavior
Stable Zig plugin interface and startup-only registration contract are explicit and testable
Handler outcome semantics, panic mapping, and built-in shadowing precedence are precisely defined
Compatibility and breaking-change boundaries are clearly documented
Traceability matrix identifies implementation modules and verification hooks

result.summary: Design artefact for EXT-03 plugin interface completed at src/design/ext-03-plugin-interface.md, defining startup-only registration, stable Zig interface/versioning boundaries, plugin-over-built-in precedence, invocation and outcome contracts, panic-to-ERROR mapping, EE-09 merge and EE-10 error routing semantics, and full module/test traceability.
